basic_info.description: Studio Apt on the Top Floor in SOMA. Roof Deck access and coin laundry on the same floor. Dishwasher included. Two blocks away from BART and close to MUNI. Easy walking distance to restaurants and bars. No parking in building. Street parking only. The unit is on 4th floor and no elavaltor in the building. No smoking and no pets please Will do basic credit check.
